name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?gid=2021-11-29.33.1) to read the bill for a [second time](https://peo.gov.au/understand-our-parliament/how-parliament-works/bills-and-laws/making-a-law-in-the-australian-parliament/). This means that they voted to agree with the main idea of the bill and will now discuss it in greater detail. ### What is the bill's main idea? According to the [bills digest](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Bills_Legislation/bd/bd2122a/22bd023), the purpose of the bill is to: > * *establish a new remote engagement program payment to be paid to job seekers who participate in a remote engagement placement and* > * *remove provisions that establish or refer to the now non-operational Community Development Employment Projects (CDEP) Scheme and related CDEP Scheme Participant Supplement.*
